post.notes: [Untangled 2026-11-28: this profile formerly merged two men. It is the John Clark of the Revolutionary-era Sussex County Clark family (son of Levin Clark in the family tree; the tree also places the same sibling set under Thomas Clark and Elizabeth Morris), born in the 1780s (tree variants 1783 and 1789) and died 1834. The 1930 census household, the marriage to Lulu Rae Carey, and the five Clark children formerly linked here belong to John Wesley Clark Jr (profile 8193, 1894-1964) and were removed; his 1930 census fact was moved to his profile. The former death year 1918 belonged to neither man.]
